subject: Next steps & proposed MAP for OrbitHealth evaluation
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@orbithealth.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: discovery recap + next steps (OrbitHealth)

Claire — thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap so we have a shared starting point and a proposed MAP (mutual action plan) to keep momentum. Please correct anything I got wrong.

What we heard from OrbitHealth (summary)
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and tail latency for our clinical summarization pipeline by ~40% while preserving output fidelity for regulatory reporting.
- Current blockers: procurement cycle (legal & vendor security review), final economic buy-in (CFO), and integration timeline with the ML infra team.
- Timeline: target pilot in Q2 (start of pilot in mid-April), production decision by end of Q2.

Stakeholder mapping (as discussed)
- Economic buyer: Marcus Leigh — CFO (final approver on spend > $200k)
- Technical lead: Amir Kaur — Head of ML infra (owns pilot sign-off & integration)
- Security / procurement contact: Jenna Ortiz — Vendor Security + Procurement (runs standard questionnaire & evidence requests)

Proposed MAP (high level)
1) Week of Mar 15 — Redwood provides a 2-week pilot plan + scope doc (owner: vanessa_ortiz)
2) Mar 22 — Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence shared (owner: redwood security, contact: sean_gallagher)
3) Apr 1 — Pilot kickoff (OrbitHealth infra + Redwood engineers)
4) Apr 21 — Pilot results review: latency/cost/QoE metrics, recommended config for production (owner: vanessa_ortiz)
5) May 5 — Procurement & legal finalization; pricing & contract (owner: OrbitHealth procurement / redwood commercial)

Open questions / asks for OrbitHealth
- Can you confirm Marcus will be engaged during pricing review (we can present a one-page economics brief)?
- Is Jenna the correct pulse for security evidence, and does OrbitHealth have a vendor portal for questionnaire uploads?
- Any preferred success metrics (beyond cost/latency) we should add to the pilot acceptance criteria?

Attachments: referenced pilot scoping template (stub) — I’ll attach the pilot plan and a short economics one-pager in a follow-up.

Next steps (immediate)
- I’ll send the formal MAP & pilot scoping doc by end of day Thu, Mar 12.
- Sean will share our SOC2 + security evidence pack and a short list of logs/retention details for Jenna.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0127
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@orbithealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@orbithealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery recap + next steps (OrbitHealth)

Thanks, Vanessa — that matches our view. A few clarifications from my side: 

- Marcus is aware of the evaluation and will join the pricing review, but initial screening will be led by our Business Ops. Expect Marcus to re-engage for formal approval around late April / early May.
- Jenna is the correct procurement/security contact. We don’t have an external vendor portal; we prefer email uploads or a secure SFTP. She’s copied.
- Pilot success criteria: in addition to latency & cost, we need to validate: 1) deterministic output for 95% of cases (no regression on clinical labels), and 2) reproducible token accounting for audit.

I attached the initial RFP and our standard security questionnaire so you can start filling pieces on your side.

Attachments: OrbitHealth-RFP-Q1.pdf; OrbitHealth-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx

>
> — V
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@orbithealth.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@orbithealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP & deliverables (OrbitHealth pilot)

Claire / Jenna — attaching the pilot scoping doc and a proposed MAP below. I’ve incorporated your acceptance criteria (determinism & token accounting). If this looks good I’ll convert to a shared checklist (Google Sheet) and track owners/due dates.

Proposed MAP (detailed)
1) Mar 15 — Scoping doc delivered (attachment: pilot_scope_orbithealth_v1.pdf) — owner: vanessa_ortiz — deliverable: signed scoping confirmation
2) Mar 18 — Security questionnaire: Redwood to pre-fill and provide evidence (attachments: SOC2 excerpt, infra diagram) — owner: sean_gallagher — deliverable: completed questionnaire + evidence bundle
3) Apr 1 — Pilot kickoff: env setup + test corpus handoff — owner: amir (OrbitHealth) / priyom_das (redwood eng) — deliverable: infra runbook + test dataset presence
4) Apr 14 — Mid-pilot checkpoint: interim metrics & adjustments — owner: vanessa_ortiz — deliverable: checkpoint slide deck
5) Apr 21 — Pilot completion & results: cost/latency/regression analysis — owner: vanessa_ortiz — deliverable: pilot results + recommended production config
6) Apr 28–May 5 — Contracting & procurement: pricing term sheet + SOW + security addendum — owner: OrbitHealth procurement / redwood commercial — deliverable: signed order form

Notes: 
- We can compress the timelines by one week if security evidence is exchanged sooner.
- For economics, I’ll prepare a 1-page CFO brief that shows modeled unit cost savings under conservative/expected/optimistic scenarios.

Action items (redwood)
- Vanessa: deliver scoping doc by EOD Mar 15 (confirmed).
- Sean: share SOC2 excerpt, infra diagram, and evidence list by Mar 18.
- Priyom: draft pilot runbook and list of integration hooks by Mar 22.

Can you confirm Marcus will be invited to the pricing readout (we’ll keep it to 20–30 minutes)? Also confirm Jenna’s preferred method for evidence transfer (email vs SFTP) and whether OrbitHealth requires additional attestations (e.g., vendor questionnaire signatures).

If that all looks right I’ll: 1) push the MAP into a shared sheet, 2) set a calendar for the Mar 22 security sync, and 3) prepare the CFO economics brief.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
